title: Milvus: push down embedding_space_hash + add observability for schema fallback

title: Embeddings: make Ollama timeouts configurable + reuse HTTP client
description: Ollama embedding provider uses hard-coded 60s timeouts and creates a new async client per call. This is slow and hard to tune for production.
acceptance_criteria: - Introduce configurable embedding timeout/retry settings for Ollama\n- Reuse a shared httpx client / pool (align with repo-wide HTTP settings)\n- Add minimal tests or smoke-check script guidance
notes:
Audit notes (2026-03-10): OllamaEmbedding (app/rag/embedding/providers/ollama.py) currently hard-codes timeout=60s, has no batching (EMBEDDING_API_BATCH_SIZE), no concurrency cap (EMBEDDING_API_MAX_CONCURRENCY), no retries/backoff (EMBEDDING_API_MAX_RETRIES/*), creates per-call clients (requests.post / new httpx.AsyncClient), and does not validate vector dimension. Also watch for a config footgun: several call sites use base_url = EMBEDDING_API_BASE or LLM_API_BASE (e.g. app/storage/vector/milvus.py), so EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama without EMBEDDING_API_BASE can silently point to the LLM endpoint. Optional follow-up: add an explicit EMBEDDING_SPACE_VERSION (or include Ollama model digest) into current_embedding_space_hash() to avoid cache/embedding_space drift when 'ollama pull' updates a tag.
Implementation notes (2026-03-10):
- Reworked app/rag/embedding/providers/ollama.py to use pooled httpx clients (app/core/http_client.py) instead of requests/per-call AsyncClient.
- Wired EMBEDDING_API_TIMEOUT_SEC / MAX_RETRIES / backoff+jitter / BATCH_SIZE / MAX_CONCURRENCY; added response-shape + dimension validation.
- Added unit tests: tests/test_ollama_embedding_provider.py (pooled client use, retry, dimension mismatch).
Verification: ruff ok; targeted pytest ok (see test_ollama_embedding_provider + test_openai_compat_base_url). Full suite in this container fails due to unrelated faiss import + sparse SPLADE smoke test; tracked separately.
close_reason: Implemented pooled httpx client reuse + configurable timeout/retry/batching/concurrency for Ollama embeddings; added tests.

title: Connectors: upgrade minio_bucket from resume-only to true incremental+delete
description: minio_bucket currently slices a one-time object listing via cursor (resume-only). Upgrade to manifest-based incremental sync with remove/disable semantics for production correctness.
acceptance_criteria:
- Persist source_manifest (object_key -> etag/last_modified) in connector config state
- Compute delta + removed keys per run; removed objects soft-disable connector-managed docs
- No-op reruns do not reingest; resumed reruns behave correctly
- Add focused tests for partial failure + resumed run
notes:
Agent audit (2026-03-10): minio_bucket is resume-only today.
- Registry marks supports_incremental=False; state_keys=(cursor,total_objects): app/services/connector_registry.py.
- Implementation lists objects then slices by cursor; generates presigned URLs and ingests via URL path: app/api/v1/connectors.py (_execute_minio_bucket_run).
- Delete reconcile currently impossible/reliable because soft-disable helper matches doc_metadata.source_url, but URL ingest stores presigned URL (unstable per run): app/api/v1/documents.py + app/api/v1/connectors.py.
Proposed approach:
- Use a stable identity (prefer: write doc_metadata.source_url=minio://bucket/object_name; or implement disable-by-source_ref).
- Persist source_manifest {object_name -> etag/last_modified} in connector config state; compute delta + no-op reruns; update manifest only on success.
- For delete reconcile: avoid `break` at max_objects; scan full prefix or at least ensure all tracked keys observed before treating as removed; consider soft_delete flag; include source_scope_hash to invalidate stale state when config changes.

title: Wave25: Enterprise Groups + Group-based ACL
description:
现状：MimirQ 已具备顶尖 RAG 的检索/评测/运维闭环，但企业落地的最大短板仍在身份与权限生命周期：
- ACL 只能按 user allowlist；缺少 tenant groups/目录
- 连接器无法继承源系统组权限（Confluence/GitHub/Drive 等）
- 无 SCIM/SAML 的企业级入离职与 access review 闭环

本 Epic 先把‘组’与‘组权限’做成可用的基础设施（fail-closed, tenant-safe），并提供 OIDC groups claim 的 opt-in 同步，为后续源 ACL 继承、access review、SCIM 做地基。
acceptance_criteria:
- 支持 tenant-scoped groups + membership 管理（API）
- Dataset/Document 的 partial 访问控制同时支持 member + group allowlist
- 检索侧 security trimming 端到端生效（documents/evidence/chat）
- OIDC groups claim 同步（opt-in）可把 token 中 groups 写入本地 groups/memberships（有上限、可审计）
- 单测覆盖关键权限路径；文档更新

Root cause: web devDependencies used ESLint 10, but eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 only supports ESLint < 10, which crashed linting.
